description: Lists a page of balance transactions for the connected Stripe account. Supports filtering by date range, currency, type, payout, or source, as well as cursor-based pagination.

inputSchema.description: Request model for listing balance transactions with optional filtering and pagination.

created.description: Only return transactions that were created during the given date interval. Use Unix timestamps as keys: 'gt', 'gte', 'lt', 'lte'.
created.title: Created

currency.description: Only return transactions in a certain currency. Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code, in lowercase.
currency.title: Currency

ending_before.description: A cursor for pagination. Returns only transactions created before this object ID.
ending_before.title: Ending Before

expand.description: Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.
expand.title: Expand

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.
limit.title: Limit

payout.description: For automatic Stripe payouts only, only returns transactions that were paid out on the specified payout ID.
payout.title: Payout

source.description: Only returns transactions associated with the given object.
source.title: Source

starting_after.description: A cursor for pagination. Returns only transactions created after this object ID.
starting_after.title: Starting After

type.description: Only returns transactions of the given type. One of: adjustment, advance, advance_funding, anticipation_repayment, application_fee, application_fee_refund, charge, climate_order_purchase, climate_order_refund, connect_collection_transfer, contribution, inbound_transfer, inbound_transfer_reversal, issuing_authorization_hold, issuing_authorization_release, issuing_dispute, issuing_transaction, obligation_outbound, obligation_reversal_inbound, payment, payment_failure_refund, payment_network_reserve_hold, payment_network_reserve_release, payment_refund, payment_reversal, payment_unreconciled, payout, payout_cancel, payout_failure, payout_minimum_balance_hold, payout_minimum_balance_release, refund, refund_failure, reserve_transaction, reserved_funds, reserve_hold, reserve_release, stripe_fee, stripe_fx_fee, stripe_balance_payment_debit, stripe_balance_payment_debit_reversal, tax_fee, topup, topup_reversal, transfer, transfer_cancel, transfer_failure, transfer_refund, or fee_credit_funding.
type.title: Type
